vendor_api_version: Plaid API 2020-09-14, OpenAPI revision 1.740.1, as served 2026-09-28

divergences.reason: Plaid's matching algorithm is not published; its docs give only the score bands (name 100 perfect, 85 to 99 strong, 70 to 84 partial, under 70 a mismatch; phone and email 100 perfect, 70 to 99 partial; address 100, 90 to 99 strong, 70 to 89 partial). The emulator's scorers are its own simple rules that land inside those bands: names by the words they share, phones by their last ten digits, emails with a +tag as a partial match, addresses by street, city, region and postal code. A given input will not score the same as it does at Plaid. Do not write tests that depend on a particular score value; rely on the 70 threshold Plaid recommends. is_nickname_match is always false and phone extensions are not scored. A business name that is not an exact match scores 0, and a phone number never scores in the partial band; only 100 or 0 is returned for a phone number.
divergences.operator_note: Stated in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#435 and merged by the operator. How an app emulator should declare behaviour computed by a vendor's proprietary algorithm is the open question in factory:21 (definition of done 6), so this entry is free text until that is decided.

divergences.reason: Plaid does not publish how it detects recurring streams. The emulator's own rule: rows on one account with the same name (case and punctuation ignored), the same sign and the same currency form a stream when every gap between their dates fits WEEKLY (6 to 8 days), BIWEEKLY (12 to 16), MONTHLY (27 to 33) or ANNUALLY (355 to 375); three or more rows are MATURE and two are EARLY_DETECTION. SEMI_MONTHLY, UNKNOWN and TOMBSTONED are never emitted, amounts are not considered, and stream ids, predicted_next_date and is_active follow this rule, not Plaid's. A new Item has no stream because it starts with two non-recurring rows.
divergences.operator_note: Stated in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#441 and merged by the operator. The proprietary-algorithm declaration question is open in factory:21.

divergences.reason: A new Item starts with three accounts taken from the sample response on plaid.com/docs/api/accounts: Plaid Checking, Plaid 401k and Plaid Student Loan. Plaid's Sandbox gives a larger default set that is not published, so a credit card and the other account types are missing. Only the checking account has bank numbers (account 1111222233330000, routing 021000021, from the Sandbox institutions page; wire routing is not published). The same holder, the one in the identity sample, is on every account. Account ids are random per Item. Provisional until an authenticated Sandbox capture replaces it.
divergences.operator_note: Approved by the operator on 2026-10-20 as provisional seed data from published samples. The strategy for seed data and snapshot testing is open in factory:21.

divergences.reason: The emulator knows 22 institutions: Plaid's published list of 20 Sandbox institutions and published sample rows (Bank of America, Theoretical Bank, and the full Houndstooth Bank). Plaid also serves its Production institutions in Sandbox; those are absent. For most Sandbox institutions the docs publish a name only, so products are a template copied from the Houndstooth Bank sample, routing numbers are empty, country is US unless the list says Canadian or UK, and names drop the docs' parenthetical notes. Search does not leave out institutions Plaid does not support for new connections (ins_133402 is returned). Institution status and options.routing_numbers are not modelled.
divergences.operator_note: Built in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#430 and merged by the operator, under the 2026-10-20 approval of provisional seed data from published samples.

divergences.route: POST /transactions/sync, POST /transactions/get (starting rows and created rows)
divergences.reason: A new Item starts with the two transactions in Plaid's /transactions/get example, with new ids and dates moved so the newest is the day before the emulator's today. Plaid's Sandbox generates a long history that is not published, so paging needs rows created with /sandbox/transactions/create, which takes up to ten a call. A created row has no merchant, counterparties, location or logo, and its category fields are omitted. This is the published-rows-only choice, taken by default on 2026-10-26 and reversible; a derived history generator is not built.
divergences.operator_note: Taken as the default on 2026-10-26 when the operator asked to move on without choosing the transactions option; the operator has not decided otherwise. The seed data strategy is open in factory:21.

divergences.reason: The update status is always HISTORICAL_UPDATE_COMPLETE; NOT_READY and INITIAL_UPDATE_COMPLETE are never returned because rows are available at once. The options object is accepted and ignored. Personal finance category v1 is not served, only v2. A change that lands while a client is paging waits for the next run, instead of Plaid's TRANSACTIONS_SYNC_MUTATION_DURING_PAGINATION error. The messages for a bad cursor and an out-of-range count are the emulator's wording. A personal_finance_category_version request option is ignored: v2 is always served. Plaid returns PRODUCT_NOT_READY for no route in this emulator, and its docs say /transactions/sync never does.
divergences.operator_note: Stated in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#438 and merged by the operator.

divergences.reason: A Plaid-Version other than 2020-09-14 answers 400 INVALID_REQUEST UNSUPPORTED_API_VERSION, after the credentials are checked. Plaid's own answer to another version is not observed. A missing header is accepted as 2020-09-14.
divergences.operator_note: Decided by the operator on 2026-10-14 (OD-3): a declared 400 for another version. The error code is the emulator's own.

divergences.reason: Nine webhooks with a published sample body can be fired: ITEM NEW_ACCOUNTS_AVAILABLE, LOGIN_REPAIRED, PENDING_DISCONNECT, USER_PERMISSION_REVOKED and USER_ACCOUNT_REVOKED; TRANSACTIONS DEFAULT_UPDATE, SYNC_UPDATES_AVAILABLE and RECURRING_TRANSACTIONS_UPDATE; AUTH DEFAULT_UPDATE. Plaid lets this endpoint fire more: AUTHORIZATION_GRANTED, SMS_MICRODEPOSITS_VERIFICATION, DEFAULT_UPDATE for IDENTITY, INVESTMENTS_TRANSACTIONS, LIABILITIES and HOLDINGS, and the Assets webhooks PRODUCT_READY and ERROR. Those answer 400 INVALID_REQUEST INVALID_FIELD 'not supported by this emulator'. DEFAULT_UPDATE without a webhook_type defaults to TRANSACTIONS, which the docs do not state. The documented overrides object is not read.
divergences.operator_note: Built in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#432 and merged by the operator.

divergences.route: outbound webhook deliveries (retries and which webhooks are sent)
divergences.reason: A failed delivery is retried by the kit's dispatcher, three attempts one second apart, then dropped. Plaid retries for up to 24 hours starting after 30 seconds with each delay four times the last, and honours Retry-After. No circuit breaker is implemented. A receiver gets a webhook within 10 seconds or the attempt fails, as at Plaid. INITIAL_UPDATE, HISTORICAL_UPDATE and TRANSACTIONS_REMOVED are never sent, nor the webhooks Plaid sends from its periodic extraction. The environment field is always sandbox. The order of webhooks is not guaranteed, as at Plaid.
divergences.operator_note: Built in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#431 and WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#442 and merged by the operator.

divergences.reason: A refresh reports to the Item's webhook what changed since the last report: DEFAULT_UPDATE with the number of new rows, and SYNC_UPDATES_AVAILABLE only once /transactions/sync has run on the Item. Creating a transaction on its own sends nothing, and the Item's two starting rows are never reported. A refresh with nothing new sends nothing. No extraction is run because rows are available at once.
divergences.operator_note: Built in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#442 and merged by the operator.

divergences.reason: Of the Sandbox error passwords, the 22 error_{CODE} codes with a published sample are simulated. COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED and USER_SHOULD_VERIFY_DEPOSIT_ALLOCATIONS are listed by Plaid but have no published sample, so they are accepted and not simulated. The multi-factor test passwords, the recaptcha password, the persona users and user_transactions_dynamic, and custom Sandbox users are not modelled: any username is accepted and every Item gets the same accounts. The error passwords are honoured only for user_good or no username. The error passwords are not refused for OAuth institutions, where Plaid does not support them (quirk LIFECYCLE-005). An institution_id the emulator does not list is refused with INVALID_INSTITUTION; initial_products is not checked against the products the institution supports.
divergences.operator_note: Built in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#419 and merged by the operator. The plan's acceptance was changed to follow the docs on 2026-10-21.

divergences.reason: Plaid Link is not emulated, so update mode cannot complete: a link token created with an access_token is issued and can be read back, but nothing repairs an Item in ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED short of /admin/reset or linking a new Item. Plaid also moves Sandbox Items into ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED 30 days after creation, which the emulator does not do. reset_login does send the ITEM ERROR webhook, as Plaid documents.
divergences.operator_note: Stated in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#419 and merged by the operator. The research quirk LIFECYCLE-003 says Sandbox Items auto-expire after 30 days; its status_2026_09_28 is NOT-FOUND, so the claim is documented but not yet confirmed from the Sandbox. The emulator does not model the expiry.

divergences.reason: The emulator issues a processor token or a btok_ Stripe bank account token for a checking account and revokes them with the Item, but nothing redeems them: no processor-partner route honours a processor token, the one-time use of the Stripe token is not enforced, and the Stripe app emulator in this repo does not accept a btok_ token, so the Plaid to Stripe flow does not work end to end. An account without bank numbers answers NO_AUTH_ACCOUNTS, which is the nearest documented error, not a published answer. The processor list is Plaid's documented one.
divergences.operator_note: Built in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#436 and merged by the operator. The Stripe-side acceptance of btok_ tokens is not planned yet.

divergences.reason: Only accounts that carry bank numbers are returned (the checking account), with wire_routing null because it is not published. An Item without the auth product gets 400 ITEM_ERROR PRODUCT_NOT_ENABLED; Plaid does not document which product error this route returns. Plaid returns a different error for an account type it does not serve; the emulator uses NO_AUTH_ACCOUNTS. Micro-deposit fields are not modelled.
divergences.operator_note: Built in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#434 and merged by the operator.

divergences.reason: Link tokens are issued and read back; the Link flow itself, redirect URIs, hosted Link and Link events are not emulated. The public token still comes from /sandbox/public_token/create. An expired link token is read as unknown.
divergences.operator_note: Built in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#408 and merged by the operator.

divergences.reason: Error codes and types follow Plaid's published samples. The message text is Plaid's for the codes it publishes a sample for (the unauthenticated errors the research probed, the item and institution errors, INVALID_ACCESS_TOKEN, INVALID_PUBLIC_TOKEN, INVALID_LINK_TOKEN, ITEM_NOT_FOUND, MISSING_FIELDS, INVALID_BODY, INVALID_INSTITUTION, INVALID_ACCOUNT_ID, INVALID_WEBHOOK_VERIFICATION_KEY_ID and the Sandbox errors). For the rest it is the emulator's wording: INVALID_FIELD for dates, count, offset, cursor and webhook codes, UNSUPPORTED_API_VERSION, MISSING_FIELDS for a missing identity match user, the expired public token message, and the processor INVALID_FIELD message. Match on error_code, not error_message.
divergences.operator_note: Messages marked as inferred in the merged slice PRs; the authenticated Sandbox capture (OD-6) would settle them.

divergences.reason: Rate limits are not emulated. No route answers 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, there are no per-endpoint limits, and there is no way to set one. The kit's rate limiter is not mounted on any route, and its 429 body is not Plaid's error shape.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-26: community app emulators do not emulate rate limits.

divergences.reason: By default any non-empty client_id and secret pair is accepted, from the body or from the PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET headers, so INVALID_API_KEYS is not returned. Set the PLAID_CLIENT_ID and PLAID_SECRET environment variables to enforce a pair; each is enforced on its own, and an unset one accepts any value. A missing credential is always MISSING_FIELDS.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-26: keep any-pair credentials as the default and declare it.

divergences.reason: Accepted on any Item, including one linked without the transactions product. The research (event-model.md) says Plaid allows the route only for Items created with the user_transactions_dynamic test user, which this app emulator does not model. Created rows appear in /transactions/sync and /transactions/get like the starting rows.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-26: leave transactions/create open to any Item and declare it.

divergences.reason: Balances do not follow transactions: creating, modifying or removing a transaction leaves every account's balances as they were. Plaid's documentation states no rule that ties Sandbox balances to Sandbox transactions, so none is invented here.
divergences.operator_note: Not implemented on purpose. The research quirk LIFECYCLE-006 notes an app emulator could be consistent; no vendor rule exists to copy, and the operator decides if one should be designed.

divergences.reason: These routes answer 400 ITEM_ERROR PRODUCT_NOT_ENABLED, with Plaid's documented message, for an Item linked without the product (identity or transactions). The code is the same for every gated route: Plaid documents PRODUCT_NOT_ENABLED, PRODUCT_NOT_READY and PRODUCTS_NOT_SUPPORTED but not which route returns which, and PRODUCT_NOT_READY is never returned. /accounts/get, /accounts/balance/get, the processor token routes and /sandbox/transactions/create check no product. initial_products is not checked against the products an institution supports.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-26: enforce product gating. Which gated route returns which product error is not documented by Plaid.

divergences.reason: /admin/webhooks/flush is not wired: it answers that no webhooks are configured, because deliveries are sent as they are queued and a flush would send every queued event a second time. /admin/reset clears queued webhooks and the delivery log, but an attempt already in flight when the reset arrives can still finish. The signing key survives a reset on purpose, so a receiver's cached key stays valid.
divergences.operator_note: Decision made during the build and repeated in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#452.

divergences.reason: These routes are the emulator's own and have no Plaid equivalent. Plaid has no public call that changes or removes a transaction, so a test that needs /transactions/sync to report modified and removed rows uses them. They take no Plaid credentials, change a row's name, amount, date or pending flag or remove it, and send no webhook.
divergences.operator_note: Added in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin#453 so the modified and removed arrays of /transactions/sync are reachable over HTTP.

divergences.reason: A fault injected through /admin/fault runs before Plaid's request checks, so a faulted route does not answer a bad Content-Type, an unparsable body or missing credentials first. A fault that carries no body answers the kit's default body, which is not Plaid's error shape; give the fault a Plaid-shaped body.
divergences.operator_note: Order and default body come from the public kit's middleware, which this app emulator does not change.

divergences.reason: persistent_account_id is never populated. Plaid fills it for some institutions; omitting it is valid for the SDKs because the field is optional.
divergences.operator_note: Not implemented. The community audit of 2026-10-26 found it.

divergences.reason: Optional fields the SDKs allow to be absent are not sent: an Item's institution_name and auth_method, an account's verification_status, verification_name, verification_insights, apy and holder_category, balances.last_updated_datetime, ACH can_transfer_in and can_transfer_out, an institution's status, and a link token's hosted_link_url, link_sessions and user_id. A recurring stream's category is always null even when its transactions carry one.
divergences.operator_note: Found by the community audit of 2026-10-26. plaid-python 44.0.0 deserialises every response without them, as the SDK smoke run shows.
